verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm the file-based Logseq keeps local data as markdown files that users sync with GitHub, and describe it as offline-first (logseq-comm-1, logseq-comm-7, logseq-comm-20), consistent with the vendor's 'privacy-first' positioning. However, the newer DB version moves notes into a database instead of plain markdown, so direct readability without the app is no longer guaranteed (logseq-comm-14, logseq-comm-11), and generated markdown has compatibility quirks (logseq-comm-19); export to Markdown, JSON and other formats partially mitigates this (logseq-docs-30). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of on-disk file storage and full offline operation, plain-file readability in the DB version, and hands-on verification of offline behavior.
